title: Is my phone compatible with NovaTel's 5G network?
content:
Question: Is my phone compatible with NovaTel's 5G network?

Answer: Check Device Compatibility under Help > Device Support and enter your IMEI or device model. Compatibility depends on supported 5G NR bands (n1/n3/n78 etc.) and whether the handset is carrier-unlocked for our network.

Topic: Device Compatibility
